summary: The queue still annotates C rnd(100) in mkshop(), but the earlier source owner is mklev.c mk_knox_portal(). Its C deferral condition evaluates rn2(3) only when the Ludios source is unset and wizard mode is false; js/mklev.js:875 evaluates rn2(3) for wizard mode too, shifting the stream before mkshop reaches its line-193 roll. The smallest current scope is a divergence fix to that wizard-gated condition. The prior mkshop source trace remains useful for the later ordinary-room and SHOPTYPE path; after this RNG fix, the accepted portal branch still has a separate JS placement stub at line 884.

source.branch: makelevel() calls mk_knox_portal() after realizing a secret vault. The helper chooses Fort Ludios branch source end2 when the current level is Knox end1, otherwise returns on an existing dungeon branch. When source->dnum is already assigned it returns without a draw; when the source is unassigned, C draws rn2(3) only if !wizard and defers on a nonzero result. An unassigned source in wizard mode therefore consumes no rn2(3), then passes only on a main-dungeon, non-Quest-entry level with depth > 10 and below Medusa.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:1315-1333 makelevel() realizes and fills a vault, then calls mk_knox_portal() before the makevtele() roll.
js/mklev.js:741-765 makelevel() mirrors vault realization and calls js mk_knox_portal() before its makeniche() roll.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/src/dungeon.c dungeon_branch(), on_level(), Is_branchlev(), depth(), and at_dgn_entrance() supply branch lookup and eligibility; js/dungeon.js and js/mklev.js provide their current counterparts.

The exact C condition is nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:2643-2651: source->dnum < svn.n_dgns || (rn2(3) && !wizard). js/mklev.js:872-882 currently uses source.dnum < g.n_dgns || rn2(3), omitting the !g.wizard gate.

If the corrected precondition accepts the portal, C continues through dungeon.c insert_branch() and mklev.c place_branch(); js/mklev.js:884-887 still throws UnsupportedSpecialRoomError there, a separate subsequent missing branch beyond this first RNG cause.
The already-matching mkshop path remains source-traced in mkroom.c:101-215 and js/mkroom.js:342-489, including SHOPTYPE dispatch, candidate filters, rnd(100), topology, and FILL_NORMAL handoff.

evidence: .cache/scan-cache.json at commit ec7ccd2377ae74bfd15e9f39301aa1adbef4c3a9 reports the assigned row at step 772: C rnd(100)=24 from mkshop(mkroom.c:193), JS rn2(7)=1, recordedSteps 1814, and remainingScreensUpperBound 1042.
nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:2624-2659 defines mk_knox_portal(); line 2644 short-circuits the rn2(3) call when wizard is true, while preserving the draw for non-wizard unassigned sources.
js/mklev.js:864-887 mirrors the helper but line 875 uses source.dnum < g.n_dgns || rn2(3), so wizard mode consumes the extra rn2(3) before the later mkshop rnd(100) boundary.

The production call chain is source-general: makelevel() vault realization -> mk_knox_portal() -> subsequent special-room selection including mkshop(); the current actionable change is the source-aligned wizard precondition, with no session-specific values.
